description: **Astrolabe 0.17.9** — the search engine is vendored at 0.17.9, and tool execution returns to direct dispatch.
**Imagine build strategy** — media tools can be compiled out by the Imagine build strategy via the `IMAGINE_TOOL_IDS` manifest.
**Removed built-ins** — the built-in web_search tool is removed and web retrieval goes through MCP servers; the send_feedback tool and the /feedback command are removed.
**Safer indexing** — indexing access hardened across pager/shell/update/tools (`indexing_slicing` cleared); workspace clippy warnings at zero.
